characteristics.$text: **1 SOUL**

characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.$text: Line 4

characteristics.name: Tag
characteristics.$text: Self

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **Effect:** Create two or (5+) three corpses in free adjacent spaces, then *mutate*.

characteristics.name: Tag
characteristics.$text: Range 1-2.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**Effect:** Create a perfect copy of an allied unit in range in any other free space
in range. Then *obliterate* the original as it collapses into flesh and replace it with a corpse token.

characteristics.name: Tag
characteristics.$text: Range 1-3.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**Effect:** Remove up to three negative tokens from a unit, then it may step 1 and it *mutates*. 
**Spare Parts:** The unit *mutates* and steps once for each negative token removed instead.

characteristics.name: Tag
characteristics.$text: Range 1-3.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **Effect:** Choose a unit in range. That unit may step 2. If it ends its turn in the space of a corpse, it *mutates*, removes the corpse, then may step 2 and *mutate* again.

characteristics.name: Tag
characteristics.$text: Attack, range 2-4.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**On hit:** 1 toxin damage. 
**Effect:** At end of target’s nextturn, they explode for a *splash* (target) effect for 1 toxin damage. Your allies in the area *mutate* instead of taking damage.

characteristics.name: Tag
characteristics.$text: Attack, Range 2-4.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**On hit:** May remove one positive token from target, then deal 1 toxin damage. 
**Spare Parts:** If at least one corpse was consumed, repeat this effect, but no more than once this turn.

characteristics.name: Tag
characteristics.$text: Line 3.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**Effect:** Line: 1 fire damage and inflict 1 *vulnerable*, (3-4) OR 1 toxic damage and inflict 1 *slow*, (5-6) OR 1 curse damage and inflict 1 *weak*. 
**Spare Parts:** Roll 1D for effect per corpse consumed and choose any result.

characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.name: Tag
characteristics.$text:
Own or allied turn
Range 1-3

characteristics.name: Cost
characteristics.$text: **2 SOUL**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
**Trigger:** Turn start.
**Effect:** Remove up to three mutation tokens from target, then target gains +1D on attacks this turn per token removed. If three or more were removed, their damage gains pierce.

characteristics.name: Tag
characteristics.$text:
Curse
Any Turn
Range 1-4

characteristics.name: Cost
characteristics.$text: **3 SOUL**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:

**Effect:** Deal 1 toxic damage to unit. If this reduces them to 0 hp, they are *obliterated*. Create up to 3 corpse tokens under their space or in free adjacent spaces.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:

**Effect:** Inflict 2 *slow*, *weak*, and *vulnerable* on target foe.

characteristics.name: Description
